title: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise Platform
searchText: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise Platform Fivetran  From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. Job Description We automate the most tedious parts of the data stack—so data arrives in the warehouse ready to query, transform, and power insight. No maintenance, no manual effort, just trusted data delivered at scale. Today, thousands of the world’s most data-driven companies—spanning Fortune 500s to high-growth startups—rely on Fivetran to move billions of records daily and execute millions of transformations through our platform. With ever-increasing demand for data in AI and analytics workflows, we’re building the infrastructure to power the next generation of intelligent business. About the Role As a Product Manager on our Enterprise Platform team, you’ll shape the foundation that makes Fivetran scalable, secure, and extensible for thousands of enterprise customers. You’ll lead key initiatives across the platform–enterprise-grade security and governance, user and workspace configuration, and observability tooling—ensuring customers can confidently configure, govern, and scale Fivetran usage. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role, perfect for product leaders who thrive on technical challenges, tight feedback loops, and opportunities to shape long-term platform strategy. You’ll balance usability and self-service with enterprise-grade requirements like scale, security, and governance. This is a full-time position based out of our Denver, CO office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. What You’ll Do Define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for key platform features Partner closely with engineering and design to define and deliver robust, intuitive functionality that meets the needs of enterprise customers. Understand customer needs by engaging directly with users, analyzing feedback and usage data, and collaborating with support, sales, and solutions engineering. Drive cross-functional alignment and go-to-market readiness for major product launches. Stay on the pulse of trends in developer platforms, data infrastructure, and enterprise tooling—with an eye toward AI-first opportunities. Skills We’re Looking For Product management experience in B2B SaaS or cloud platforms. A strong technical foundation—comfortable working on APIs, backend systems, developer tools, or security platforms. A track record of owning complex initiatives and delivering high-impact outcomes for technical users. Exceptional collaboration and communication skills across product, engineering, and go-to-market teams. Analytical mindset and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Bonus Skills Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tooling (e.g., ELT/ETL, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, Snowflake, Databricks). Experience with enterprise security and compliance standards (e.g., SSO, RBAC, audit logging, SOC2). Prior work on developer tools, SDKs, or extensibility platforms. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Denver Pay Range $188,496 — $235,620 USD Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays, and volunteer days off RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.
